title: Phase 1 nanostores store layer
description: Implement framework-agnostic nanostores for the shopping-list PWA Phase 1: categories, catalog (master item pool), active list (with checked state), history (shopping events only), user (name/photo with random defaults), and computed selectors for the main screen. Persistence via @nanostores/persistent. No tests/docs in this pass.

title: Implement Phase 1 nanostores module
description: Create src/stores/ with types.ts (shared shapes), categories.ts ($categories + add/rename/removeCategory), catalog.ts ($catalog + addItemToCatalog/editItem/removeItemFromCatalog), list.ts ($list + addToList/removeFromList/toggleChecked, logging history), history.ts ($history + logHistory), user.ts ($user + setUser/randomizeDefaults), selectors.ts (computed $itemsByCategory etc.), and index.ts (onMount seeding from items_categories.json + logger wiring). History logs ONLY add/remove-from-list; deletes/edits of catalog items and categories do NOT write history.
